games.design: Read a kg repeated b times, choose total weight. Left pan holds exactly b blocks labelled a. Before answering the left side hangs lower; chosen heavier/lighter weight produces physically consistent tilt, equality settles horizontal.
games.reward: Panda four-pose celebration, equality sign, light ring.
games.learning: Same total weight demonstrates a repeated b times. Wrong feedback distinguishes too heavy and too light.

games.design: Three stationary readable number insects. One selected answer sends the tongue to that exact insect. Correct capture produces skin-pattern rewards; wrong choice receives correct-value feedback.
games.firstTap: Three catch buttons corresponding to the three insects.
games.reward: Green mascot four poses, animated wings, extending/retracting tongue, collectible color spots.
games.learning: Stable positions avoid a motor-speed requirement; timing only adds bonus.

games.design: One missing tile blocks the chain. Correct chosen tile slots into the gap, dominoes topple sequentially, windmill spins, persistent flags illuminate.
games.reward: Hamster four poses, sequenced physical domino fall, 5 flags and final machine celebration.
games.learning: The numeric answer is the missing arithmetic result. Other tiles bear musical symbols, not misleading arithmetic counts.

games.design: Correct answers remove frosted blocks from an original mystery character. Three successes fully reveal a friendly wolf in a bunny costume; full reveal is retained for remaining rounds.
games.firstTap: Choose the answer to focus the picture once.
games.reward: Four animated poses, screen reception bars, progressive reveal and final dance.
games.learning: No second identity-guess input competes with multiplication. Wrong answer does not erase earned reveal.
